comment: design-sync esbuild alias map. The bundled tsconfigPathsPlugin returns the first existsSync hit, and an empty-extension probe matches a DIRECTORY (Windows: 'Incorrect function' when esbuild reads it as a file). So every barrel directory under src/ that is imported as a bare '@/<dir>' MUST be pinned to its index file (a non-extension '/index' stem lets the plugin's ext loop pick .ts or .tsx) and listed BEFORE the '@/*' wildcard. baseUrl points at frontend/ so the './src/*' targets resolve there.
